semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides advanced X-ray analytical services and equipment specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Scientific Gear Service Co., Ltd. specializes in providing advanced X-ray analytical services and equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include ultra-fast X-ray CT systems for real-time monitoring, strain and defect analyzers for SiC ingots and wafers, and high-flux X-ray sources. They also supply photon-counting detectors with high quantum efficiency, supporting both research and manufacturing processes.
